title: Chapter 2790 - 116: Kneel Down_3
content:
Chapter 2790: Chapter 116: Kneel Down_3

He escaped.

And as he escaped, the original battle of attrition had a breach, and "Sishen" was less suppressed by one round.

With the gap opened, Sishen’s first target was none other than the fleeing Shugu Fourth.

Sishen bypassed Lugu, broke through the blockade of Chi Feng and Dan Zhu, and with a few swift moves, directly grabbed Shugu Fourth who was escaping.

A cold, foul-smelling large hand clutched Fourth’s neck.

Shugu Fourth’s eyes widened in terror.

Lugu watched as Fourth fell into Sishen’s hands, horrified.

Sishen, even without "feeding," was already so terrifying.

Once Sishen really consumes the blood and flesh of Golden Core Realm Fourth, nourished by the Golden Core, no one knows what monster he might mutate into.

Lugu and Chi Feng wanted to save Fourth, but they were already too late.

Sishen hadn’t fed for too long, was too ravenous, and his movements were faster than anyone’s; almost at the moment of capturing Fourth, he had already opened his mouth and bitten down.

Blood splattered, and the flesh was instantly sucked in like a liquid by enormous suction.

Fourth screamed in terror, as if mourning for his mother.

And having consumed the Golden Core flesh, Sishen’s aura skyrocketed instantly, and his bloody skin started self-repairing at an astonishing speed.

Lugu and Chi Feng’s hearts instantly sank to rock bottom.

"It’s over..."

Just at the moment this nearly despairing thought emerged in Lugu’s mind, a figure suddenly appeared in front of him.

This figure was not tall, slender, wearing the robes of a shaman, his face stunning yet solemn.

It was "Mr. Witch" Mo Hua.

Mo Hua knew better than anyone present why Sishen had become like this.

The current Sishen is an "Blood and Flesh Puppet" of the Evil God.

Its flesh has already died, and its Divine Sense has vanished.

But the will of the Evil God has occupied Sishen’s body, manipulating this flesh as a blood and flesh slave of the Divine Way, to devour others’ blood and flesh.

Therefore, throughout the earlier battle, Mo Hua has been trying to locate Sishen, aiming at his eyes.

But Sishen was too strong, his cultivation too high, in this Golden Core Realm clash, Mo Hua dared not easily intervene, for if even slightly uncareful, he’d be turned to dust.

And Sishen’s figure kept changing amidst the battle, making it impossible for Mo Hua to target him.

But Shugu Fourth being devoured by Sishen just gave Mo Hua a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.

Sishen grabbed Fourth, so its figure would definitely become fixed.

Sishen was sucking Fourth’s flesh, biting Fourth’s neck, so the direction of its head and eyes was also determined.

This momentary pause provided Mo Hua a chance for Divine Thought into sword targeting.

Mo Hua performed Water Passing Step, and with just a flash, entered the battlefield, gazing directly into Sishen’s dark and fearsome eye sockets.

"Wretch!"

Mo Hua pointed with pressed fingers on his forehead, golden light in his eyes shining like a sword, speaking in a deep voice:

"Kneel down!"

This sound of ’kneel down’ was soul-stirring.

Simultaneously, Mo Hua pressed fingers for a point, Divine Thought Out of Body, breaking the barriers of reality.

An invisible killing intent suddenly manifested, an obscure blazing golden light abruptly burst forth, akin to countless sword lights dazzling in its brilliance, heart-wrenching.

Lugu and the others only felt a flash of golden light before their eyes, a wave of terrifying fluctuation spreading, even their Sea of Consciousness felt the pressure of the blade.

A moment later, everything subsided.

When everyone looked again, they discovered an almost unbelievable scene.

That Golden Core late stage General Sishen, as if crawling out from Purgatory, tall as a mountain, horrific with blood and nearly undead, actually truly knelt down like a puppet...

Kneeling before... that Foundation Establishment shaman.

Lugu, Chi Feng, Dan Zhu, all the Golden Core Barbarian Cultivators present, were all breathless, faces full of shock.
